reasons: Claimed status (missing) is supported: the cited termination paragraphs address only notice, accrued fees and assignment of Works in progress, with no transition assistance, data return, or deletion/certification obligation anywhere in the agreement.

The inserted Section 6(c) tracks the preferred position precisely — up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return within thirty (30) days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter — and is placed in the correct (termination) section.

Edit is minimal and additive: existing paragraphs p0032/p0033 are untouched, and the new text reuses the agreement's defined terms ('Works', 'Confidential Information', 'Statement of Work') for internal consistency.

Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains what changed and why in two sentences, and offers the ninety-day fallback while preserving the thirty-day export and deletion certificate.
Deterministic checks pass and the changed-character volume is inherent to inserting a missing clause rather than an over-broad rewrite.
